research_rationale: Held Wikisource revision 12446690 identifies Wilson order dated August 22, 1914 and contains four sections. Sections 1-2 impose recurring Canal Zone street railway crossing rules; section 3 prescribes penalties; section 4 delays effect thirty days. No held ending instrument or affirmative current predicate resolves the first cessation of these separate commands.
unresolved_material_gaps: ["First cessation and legal mechanism for each of sections 1-3 are unsupported by a held ending source or current-law predicate.","Identify and examine any Canal Zone statute, regulation, treaty, or order that changed these crossing commands; a bare name search and post-1937 OFR catalog cannot establish their pre-1937 lifecycle.","Official original remains unheld; Wikisource mirror requires replacement and quotation recheck."]
earlier_end_check: No own sunset. The 30-day clause begins effect rather than ending it. No located actor provision establishes an earlier ending.
scope_check: Sections 1-2 regulate different crossing classes; section 3 penalizes violations; section 4 fixes onset. Canal Zone geographic scope does not itself prove a cessation date.
independent_command_check: The crossing rules and penalty can have separate persistence and accrued enforcement consequences; none can be collapsed into the initial effective-date clause.
savings_check: No express savings clause in the held text; possible accrued penalties and later territorial legal transitions require source-specific examination.

research_rationale: Held Wikisource revision 12442285 identifies Wilson order dated May 25, 1915 and one operative suspension of the January 15, 1915 rent, fuel, and light charges. The suspension lasts during actual Panama Canal construction but no later than June 30, 1916. Parent EO 2120 held mirror confirms the charge context; EO 2514 held OCR concerns leave and does not by itself supply this suspension ending.
unresolved_material_gaps: ["Dated primary evidence of when actual Panama Canal construction ended, to test the potentially earlier cessation of the suspension.","A citable, reviewed parent EO 2120 source and any operative change to its rent, fuel and light provisions must be reconciled; EO 2514 is only an unlocated related lead in this packet.","Official EO 2204 original remains unheld; Wikisource mirror requires replacement and quotation recheck."]
earlier_end_check: Actual construction could have ended before June 30, 1916. The held material provides no dated fact establishing when it ended; June 30 is an inclusive maximum, with July 1 the latest possible day of restored operation, not proven first cessation.
scope_check: Only rent, fuel and lights under the January 15, 1915 order are suspended; other parent commands persist. The order does not rescind its parent.
independent_command_check: One operative suspension; no separate appointment, reporting or performance command. Parent EO 2120 has multiple independent charge and rate provisions whose own lifecycle is outside this assigned identity.
savings_check: No express savings; charges accrued before suspension, if any, and any restored charges are not resolved by this text alone.
